name: Thyreosaurus
isnote: Described as a stegosaur from the El Mers III Formation (Zafaty et al. 2024); position within Stegosauria not resolved in the sources used.
sum: Thyreosaurus is a Middle Jurassic stegosaur from Morocco with unusual oblong osteoderms possibly lying flat on the back.
wsnote: Estimated body length of the not fully grown adult holotype (cited Wikipedia revision).
holotype: HIIUC-BN00, an associated but disarticulated partial skeleton with nine dorsal vertebrae, 21 ribs, a limb bone and six osteoderms — El Mers III Formation, Boulahfa North, Morocco.
biology: Its asymmetrical oblong osteoderms resemble those of nodosaurid ankylosaurs and may have lain recumbent instead of upright.
author: Zafaty et al. 2024
